name: Toller of the Death-Knell

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The toller makes two attacks, using Mace or Radiant Flame in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Creeping Dread.

Actions.name: Mace
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) Radiant damage.

Actions.name: Creeping Dread
Actions.text: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 13, one creature within 60 feet. *Failure:* The target has the Frightened condition until the end of the toller's next turn. If the target was already Frightened by this ability, it also takes 6 (1d12) Necrotic damage.
Actions.gmQuote: a chapel bell ringer's ghost that tolls for the dying

Actions.name: Radiant Flame
Actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, range 60 ft. 11 (2d10) Radiant damage.

Actions.name: Spellcasting
Actions.text:
The toller casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

- **At Will:** *Light*, *Thaumaturgy*
- **1/Day Each:** *Spirit Guardians*

Bonus Actions.name: Divine Aid (3/Day)
Bonus Actions.text: The toller casts *Bless*, *Dispel Magic*, *Healing Word*, or *Lesser Restoration*, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

Traits.name: Resonant Body
Traits.text: A creature that hits the toller with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) Thunder damage and has the Deafened condition until the end of its next turn.

lore: A bell-ringer who died mid-toll on a plague-night, still counting the dead he could not save, now tolls for each living soul whose hour has come.

generation.userConcept: a chapel bell-ringer's ghost that tolls for the dying
generation.cite: composition after Doppelganger (CR 3) — the first-round-advantage opener
